plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Spec-driven development, end to end: explore a requirement into an approved, committed spec, shut the round into an isolated worktree, build it as red-green-refactor rounds with a reproduction-first route for every fault, then a dispatched review and the project's gates before delivery. Plus init, which establishes the project's agent constraint system: AGENTS.md and layered docs, lint guardrails wired into CI, and the twin unit-test and e2e tracks. A SessionStart hook puts the bootstrap into every session.
